dialect.detail: Likely compiled with GnuCOBOL or a similar open-source COBOL compiler targeting DOS/Windows; uses SCREEN SECTION with BACKGROUND-COLOR, REVERSE-VIDEO, HIGHLIGHT, BLANK SCREEN, and box-drawing characters typical of Brazilian academic COBOL projects. DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA and Portuguese-language identifiers/messages confirm Brazilian locale.
evidence: Portuguese text: INCLUSÇO, ALTERAÇO, CONSULTA, RELATORIO

purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian academic project (FATEC RL - LTP II course) managing newspaper headlines (manchetes de jornais)
purpose.summary: A menu-driven program for managing newspaper headline records stored in a sequential file (PRIPAG.DAT). It supports inclusion, alteration, consultation, report, and an about screen. The program appears to be a student exercise from FATEC RL (a Brazilian technical college), with several features stubbed out or commented.

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION with BACKGROUND-COLOR, REVERSE-VIDEO, HIGHLIGHT
VALUE OF FILE-ID IS (old-style FD clause)
Several PERFORM targets commented out (incomplete implementation)
verdict.notes: File encoded in latin-1; Portuguese text contains garbled accented characters (e.g., INCLUSÇO, ALTERAÇO, NéMERO) due to encoding. The GRAVA paragraph has questionable nested IF logic without END-IF terminators, suggesting incomplete or buggy code. Several PERFORM calls are commented out. Authors named in TELA04: Claudio Seabra, Diego Busin Poblete, Luiz Fernando Nunes Verissimo - LTP II FATEC RL course project.
